title: Siman 354
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: בִּפְרָט מָמוֹן הַרְבֵּה, נִשְׁתַּנֶּה פָּנָיו וְנַעֲשִׂין אֶצְלוֹ שִׁנּוּיִים. אֲבָל אֶצְלִי אֲפִלּוּ אִם אֲקַבֵּל סַךְ עָצוּם בְּפַעַם אֶחָד, אֵין
segments.en:
(15.) He said: "My 'turning away from evil' is a wondrous novelty, and also my 'doing good' is very wondrous — for I truly do much good. And my Torah accomplishes very much in the world. For through my Torah all the outpourings of blessing in the world are drawn down." And he said to someone: "What is your trade?" — "You deal in wheat?" — "That too is drawn through my Torah."

He answered and said: "There are two kinds of people about whom I have great compassion — those who could draw close to me and do not draw close, and those who draw close to me but..."
